info.title: Help desk API
info.description: Backend API for the help desk. Errors always use the ErrorResponse shape. Generated from the route schemas; do not edit by hand.

get.description: Checks both database connections. 503 when any check fails.

post.summary: Sign up and create a workspace
post.description: Creates a pending workspace and emails a confirmation link. Answers the same way when the email already has an account.

post.summary: Resend the confirmation email
Confirm an email from its link and sign in

patch.summary: Update your name or colour theme

post.summary: Change your password
post.description: Signs you out on every other device and workspace; this browser gets a fresh session (new cookie and CSRF token).

post.summary: Sign out on every other device
Sign in to this workspace
post.description: Wrong password, unknown email and "not a member here" all answer 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS. Five failures for one email within 15 minutes lock it for 15 minutes (429 LOGIN_LOCKED). With two-step verification on, a correct password answers 202 and sets a short challenge cookie; send the code to /auth/login/two-factor.

post.summary: Sign out on this device
post.description: Needs the X-CSRF-Token header while the session is live.

post.summary: Email a password reset link
post.description: Answers the same way whether or not the email belongs to a member of this workspace.

post.summary: Check a password reset link before choosing a new password
Choose a new password from a reset link
post.description: Signs the person out everywhere. A used, expired or unknown link answers 400 with details.reason.

post.summary: Email links to every workspace this email can sign in to
post.description: Main address only. Answers the same way whether or not the email has an account.

post.summary: Start setting up two-step verification
post.description: Needs your password. Returns the setup key and QR code for an authenticator app; nothing changes until /me/two-factor/confirm.

post.summary: Turn on two-step verification with the first code from the app
post.description: Returns the recovery codes (shown once) and signs you out on your other devices.

post.summary: Create new recovery codes
post.description: Needs your password. The old codes stop working.

post.summary: Turn off two-step verification
post.description: Needs your password and a code (or a recovery code). 409 TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED, with details.workspaces, while a workspace you belong to requires it.

post.summary: Finish signing in with a code
post.description: After /auth/login answered 202. A code from the app or a recovery code. Wrong codes answer 401 INVALID_CODE and count toward the login lock; a missing, expired or used-up challenge answers 401 TWO_FACTOR_EXPIRED (start again with the password).

patch.description: Turning it on needs two-step verification on for yourself first (409).

post.summary: Confirm your password for sensitive actions
post.description: Allows sensitive admin actions on this session for 10 minutes. Wrong passwords count toward the login lock.

get.summary: Everyone in the workspace, by name
get.description: Every member: names, roles and status only (no emails), for choosing or filtering by an assignee. Active people first.

patch.description: Admins only. Making someone an admin needs the password confirmed in the last 10 minutes. The owner's role cannot change; a workspace keeps at least one admin.

post.summary: Deactivate a member
post.description: Admins only. Needs the password confirmed in the last 10 minutes (403 REAUTH_REQUIRED, then POST /me/reauthenticate). Signs them out of this workspace at once and unassigns their unresolved tickets. Not the owner, not yourself.

post.summary: Reactivate a member
post.description: Admins only.

post.summary: Reset a member's two-step verification
post.description: Admins only. Needs the password confirmed in the last 10 minutes (403 REAUTH_REQUIRED, then POST /me/reauthenticate). Refused (409 MEMBER_IN_OTHER_WORKSPACES) when they also belong to another workspace.

post.summary: Invite people by email
post.description: Admins only. Up to 20 at a time; inviting as an admin needs the password confirmed in the last 10 minutes. Members are skipped with a reason; inviting someone again replaces their open invitation.

post.summary: Send a fresh invitation link
post.description: Admins only. Another 7 days; the old link stops working.

post.summary: Check an invitation link before accepting
post.description: Signed out, on the workspace address. A used, expired or revoked link answers 400 with details.reason.

post.summary: Accept an invitation and sign in
post.description: New people send a name and a new password. People who already have an account send their password, and a code when they use two-step verification (400 with details.codeRequired when missing).

get.description: Admins only. Pages with a cursor; filters by time, person, category and search.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Entries at or after this time

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the person affected or who acted

get.summary: Download the filtered audit log as CSV
get.description: Admins only. Up to 10,000 rows, times in the workspace time zone and in UTC. Cells that a spreadsheet could run as a formula are made safe.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Entries at or after this time

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the person affected or who acted

get.summary: A record type's custom fields, in order (archived ones too)

post.summary: Add a custom field
post.description: Admins only (settings.manage). Returns the record type’s updated list. Dropdown and multi-select fields need at least one choice. "on_resolve" is for ticket fields only. At most 50 active fields per record type (409).

patch.summary: Change a field's label, help text, required rule, default or choices
patch.description: Admins only (settings.manage). Returns the record type’s updated list. The key and type never change.

post.summary: Archive a field (hidden from forms; values kept)
post.description: Admins only (settings.manage). Returns the record type’s updated list.

post.summary: Restore an archived field (added at the end)
post.description: Admins only (settings.manage). Returns the record type’s updated list. Refused (409) when the record type already has 50 active fields.

put.summary: Set the order of a record type’s active fields
put.description: Admins only (settings.manage). Returns the record type’s updated list. 409 when the list no longer matches the active fields.

get.description: Search matches the name, phone and every email. Pages with a cursor.

post.summary: Add a contact
post.description: Needs a name and an email or phone. Emails are unique in the workspace. With no companyId, the contact is linked to the company whose domain matches the email.

patch.description: Only the fields given change; customFields merges by key.

delete.description: Admins and supervisors (contacts.delete). Recorded in the audit log. 409 while the contact is the requester of any ticket, deleted ones included.

get.summary: A page of companies, A to Z
get.description: Search matches the name and domains. Pages with a cursor.

post.summary: Add a company
post.description: Names are unique in the workspace (ignoring case); each domain belongs to one company, and free email services are refused.

patch.description: Only the fields given change; customFields merges by key.

delete.summary: Delete a company for good (its contacts stay, without a company)
delete.description: Admins and supervisors (contacts.delete). Recorded in the audit log.

get.summary: Every team, A to Z, with its members

post.summary: Add a team
post.description: Admins only (teams.manage). Names are unique in the workspace, ignoring case. Up to 100 teams (409).

patch.description: Admins only. Only the fields given change; members replaces the list. Deactivated people can stay but not be added.

delete.summary: Delete a team (its members stay in the workspace)
delete.description: Admins only. Recorded in the audit log.

get.description: Filters take comma-separated values ("open,pending"); none means not set (type, teamId, assignee) and me is you (assignee). q matches the number (#42), subject, requester name or email, a tag, or the start of words in the description and messages. Pages with a cursor. deleted=true lists the trash (admins).

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Comma-separated, for example Team ids, or none

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: Comma-separated, for example me, none or user ids

parameters.name: overdue
parameters.description: Only tickets past a running SLA deadline

post.summary: Create a ticket
post.description: Needs a subject and a requester (contactId, or contact by name and email or phone). Status open and priority medium unless given; resolved or closed need the "required when resolving" fields.

get.summary: Your saved views and shared ones, A to Z

post.summary: Save a view
post.description: Up to 50 per person (409). shared=true needs views.manage_shared (admins and supervisors).

patch.description: Your own views; shared views also for views.manage_shared, which sharing and unsharing need too.

get.description: Up to 10, most used first; q matches the start of the tag.

patch.description: Only the fields given change; tags replaces the list; customFields merges by key. Recorded in the ticket history. 409 for a deleted ticket.

delete.summary: Move a ticket to the trash
delete.description: Admins (tickets.delete). Restorable. Recorded in the audit log.

post.summary: Bring a ticket back from the trash
post.description: Admins (tickets.delete). Recorded in the audit log.

post.summary: Merge other tickets into this one
post.description: Admins and supervisors (tickets.merge). 1 to 4 others: their messages, notes, files and tags move here; they are closed and read-only; their requesters are copied on replies. No undo; recorded in the audit log. 409 for deleted or merged tickets.

post.summary: Split a customer's message into a new ticket
post.description: Every member. Same requester, with its files; the message leaves this ticket. Answers the new ticket. 409 for messages not from the customer.

get.description: Replies, notes and forwards with their files. The description is on the ticket.

post.summary: Reply, add a note or forward
post.description: A reply goes to the requester (409 when they have no email) plus cc; a forward to "to". Replies and forwards are sent by email in the background (F13). Notes are private and can @mention members. status (replies and notes) changes the ticket too. Answers with the whole conversation. 409 for a deleted ticket.

post.summary: Send a reply or forward that could not be sent, again
post.description: Only for emailStatus "failed" (409 otherwise). Answers with the conversation.

post.summary: Upload a file for a message you are writing
post.description: multipart/form-data with one "file" part, up to ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB (413). Files that run programs (.exe, .bat, .js and similar) are refused. Send its id in attachmentIds with the message; uploads never sent are removed after a day.

delete.summary: Remove one of your uploads that was not sent

get.description: Always a download, never shown in the page. Files on messages: every member; your unsent uploads: you.

patch.summary: Change the sender name and customer notifications (admins)

post.summary: Send yourself a test email from the workspace address (admins)
Send a request through the public form (no sign-in)
post.description: Makes a ticket and emails the person that it arrived. 404 when the form is off. The answer is the same when the request is dropped (bot field filled, or too many from one person).

patch.summary: Turn the web form on or off, or change its text (admins)

post.summary: Add a rule at the end (admins)

put.summary: Put the rules in a new order (admins)

post.summary: Whether conditions would match a ticket now (admins); changes nothing

get.summary: Your canned responses and the shared ones, A to Z, with the placeholders

post.summary: Save a canned response
post.description: Up to 100 per person and 300 shared per workspace (409). Unknown placeholders are refused (400).

patch.summary: Change a canned response (your own, or shared ones if you manage them)

delete.summary: Delete a canned response (your own, or shared ones if you manage them)

get.summary: The text with its placeholders filled in for a ticket
The time zone, working hours and holidays

put.summary: Save the time zone and working hours
put.description: Each working day has one stretch of hours. At least one working day unless 24×7.

post.summary: Add a holiday
post.description: One per date; up to 200 per workspace (409).

get.summary: The SLA policies, in the order they are tried, the default last

post.summary: Add a policy with conditions, tried before the default
post.description: The first policy whose conditions match a ticket wins. Up to 50 policies (409).

put.description: Every policy id except the default, once each (409 if they changed).

patch.description: Applies to due times worked out from now on (new tickets, priority changes).

delete.summary: Delete a policy with conditions (not the default, 409)

get.summary: How many of your notifications are unread, for the bell

post.summary: Mark notifications read: the ones given, or all of yours
post.description: One id that is not yours answers 404.

get.summary: Which kinds also come to you by email, in this workspace

patch.summary: Choose which kinds also come by email; in the app they always show

get.summary: Counts for the home page and what is left to set up
get.description: Each count uses the same filters as the ticket list it opens (assignee=me, overdue=true, assignee=none, and so on).
